area: Step 7, Tj's open question (2026-10-03): should a prop bet need a sharp prop book (Kalshi, ProphetX, FanDuel, Caesars, DraftKings) to agree it is +EV before the app lists or bets it? Props only (kind == 'PROP').
trust_notes: WHAT TO TRUST. (1) My loader numbers reproduce the app's own WHAT IF lines exactly (today's rule KEPT 196 / DROPPED 63; require sharp-ranked KEPT 178 / DROPPED 81; require exchange KEPT 141 / DROPPED 118; CLV +0.83 / -0.10 / +0.78 / +0.19 / +0.27 / +1.06), so the arithmetic is right. (2) DATA TRAP: the top-level sharpVerdict says NO_SHARP for 830 props, but 812 of those had NO book page read (the field defaults to NO_SHARP); only 259 props have a verdict (ab_verdict / checkAtMs / booksTwoSided not null): PASSED 178, VETOED 63, NO_SHARP 18, not judged 1061 (80.4% of 1320). The app's generic 'Sharp veto' split (NO_SHARP 1482) is polluted the same way (BetLedger.kt Split.SHARP); the props-only what-if lines are right. Always use judged = ab_verdict.notna(). (3) The verdict is NOT from the first look: it is the first book-page read, a median 14.7 min later (mean 135 min; 54% over 5 min, 30% over 2 h; PASSED median 5.5 min, VETOED 55 min) at Novig's price of that moment, while CLV/ROI are at the first-listed price; 22 of 259 bets changed verdict between page reads. CANNOT TRUST / BIASES THAT MATTER. (a) TIME TO START confounds everything: VETOED props were first listed a median 586 min before the start, PASSED 200 (70% of VETOED vs 39% of PASSED were first listed over 6 h out); CLV is +2.05 inside 6 h and -1.00 beyond for PASSED. Controlling it, the PASSED-vs-VETOED gap is +0.1 point (se 1.0). (b) CLOSE SOURCE confounds the CLV level: 93 of the 139 PASSED closes are 'Tracker' closes (a CNO-consensus read before the start, which exists only for bets Tj placed: the same family of soft-book consensus that produced the listed EV); the independent closes (Novig's last trades with 3 or more trades) give PASSED -0.73 (34 closes) and VETOED -0.79 (28). Inside 6 h, judged props close +2.91 on Tracker closes (55) and -0.57 on non-Tracker closes (32), on both halves. So every CLV level here is flattered; compare groups only within a close source. (c) Only 39 of 55 prop games have any close and 442 of the 477 prop closes are from first looks on Oct 3-4 (157 of the 192 judged closes are from one NFL Sunday, Oct 4): the loader's date halves (H1 = first look on or before Oct 4, H2 = after) leave the second half with 35 closes in 7 games (23 PASSED, 2 VETOED, 0 NO_SHARP), which cannot test anything; I therefore also cut by game start time at the median game with a prop close (Oct 4 16:00 ET, the median of the 35 games with a judged-prop close: G1 = games starting up to then, G2 = later) and report both. Both are 'two halves of about 2 days'. (d) Judged props are the top of each CNO scan (the green check reads the best ~10 every 4 min): mean listed EV 2.05% vs 1.25%, 33% vs 14% at 2.5% or more, median 255 vs 383 min to the start, 66% vs 37% shown by the list, 42% vs 8% placed; after matching on time-to-start x listed EV the judged-minus-not-judged CLV is -0.02 point [-1.68,+1.43]. (e) Per-bet CLV sd is 3.8% (inside 6 h) to 5.2% (all judged); the game cluster effect is small (ICC about 0), so the effective sample is close to the number of closes. Per-day figures count bets LOGGED over 2.26 days dominated by one NFL Sunday, not what the auto-bet places. (f) About 70 subgroup comparisons were looked at (verdict x time x source x half x book x edge band); a lone 95% interval that excludes zero is expected by luck about 1 time in 20. Results that rest on 20-40 closes are leads, not rules. ROI is noise at these sizes (every ROI interval spans zero by 20+ points).
key_numbers: 1320 props in 55 games; 259 (19.6%, 37 games) have a sharp verdict, 1061 (80.4%, 53 games) none (no page read). Judged: PASSED 178, VETOED 63, NO_SHARP 18. First-look span 2.26 days.

PASSED minus VETOED CLV = +0.88 points [-1.05,+2.53], P(<=0) 0.19 (139 vs 44 closes); ROI difference +11.98 points [-19.86,+41.40]. By date half it flips: first-look halves H1 +1.16 [-1.08,+3.10], H2 -3.47 [-5.89,+0.13] (23 vs 2 closes); game-start halves G1 -0.47 [-2.16,+1.19] (55 vs 21 closes), G2 +2.14 [-1.05,+4.41] (84 vs 23).

Time to start: first look within 6 h: PASSED +2.05% [+1.43,+2.85] (81 closes, 28 games) vs VETOED +0.14% [-1.81,+3.90] (12 closes, 8 games); beyond 6 h: PASSED -1.00% [-2.72,+0.69] (58 closes, 22 games) vs VETOED -0.19% [-2.35,+1.40] (32, 18). Regression on 183 closes (35 games): PASSED +0.1 point (se 1.0), first look over 6 h out -2.5 points (se 1.0).
Independent closes only (Novig trades of 3 or more, no Tracker): PASSED minus VETOED +0.14 point [-1.45,+1.47] (35 vs 28 closes); on Tracker closes +0.58 [-3.91,+4.94] (93 vs 13).

Sharp book's own edge vs CLV, first look within 6 h: slope +0.43 [+0.16,+0.71] (93 closes, 29 games; G1 +0.52 on 28 closes, G2 +0.41 on 65; first-look H1 +0.56, H2 -0.01 on 16 closes); beyond 6 h: -0.15 [-0.56,+0.20] (90 closes, 23 games). Edge bands within 6 h: under 1% +0.28 (13 closes), 1-2% -0.45 (10), 2-4% +1.55% [+0.73,+2.50] (37), 4% or more +3.38% [+2.60,+4.55] (33 closes, 18 games, 85% beat).

The page's own consensus EV (ab_checkEv) explains it: within 6 h CLV on checkEv slope +0.57 (se 0.13, 98 closes, 29 games; G1 +0.86, G2 +0.44, H1 +0.58, H2 +0.64); with both in the model the sharp edge is +0.04 (se 0.19) and checkEv +0.59 (se 0.19), correlation of the two 0.74; PASSED dummy +0.4 point (se 1.3) once checkEv is in. Beyond 6 h checkEv slope -0.32 (se 0.34).

Judged props first listed within 6 h with checkEv 3% or more (no sharp condition): 63 bets / 27 games, CLV +3.13% [+2.46,+4.00] on 54 closes (76% beat); H1 +3.01 (44 closes), H2 +3.64 (10); G1 +3.61 (21), G2 +2.82 (33); but Tracker closes +4.05 (35) vs independent closes -0.05 [-0.81,+0.52] (15 closes, 11 games). Adding PASSED changes nothing (55 bets, +3.06%); the 4 VETOED in that cell (3 closes) closed +3.43%.

Which book: exchange PASSED 141 bets / 24 games CLV +0.27% [-1.01,+1.21] (108 closes) vs originating-book (FanDuel/Caesars/DraftKings) PASSED 37 / 21 games +2.55% [+1.34,+3.90] (31 closes, 77% beat); difference +2.28 points [+0.70,+4.00] (G1 +2.26, G2 +2.30); within the same Tracker-close source +2.48 (25 closes) vs +0.52 (68). Kalshi PASSED 63 bets -1.38% [-3.02,-0.11] (41 closes, 20 games, 41% beat) vs ProphetX PASSED 78 bets +1.29% [-0.25,+2.49] (67 closes, 17 games, 70% beat): difference +2.67 [+0.89,+4.51] (G1 +4.65, G2 +1.57 [-0.77,+3.58]). Caesars PASSED 18 bets +4.05% [+2.61,+5.51] on 16 closes.

Exchange on the page: judged props where Kalshi or ProphetX prices both sides (202 bets) CLV +0.15% [-0.91,+1.02] (150 closes, 26 games) vs none (57 bets) +2.28% [+1.10,+3.45] (42 closes, 23 games): difference +2.13 points [+0.76,+3.57] (G1 +1.63, G2 +2.48; within 6 h +1.87 [+0.15,+3.47]); on independent closes only +1.05 [-0.09,+2.04] (9 vs 58 closes); with early and checkEv controlled the exchange coefficient is -1.8 points (se 0.9).

REQUIRE AN EXCHANGE drops 55 of today's 196 kept props (24.4 a day logged, 27 games): CLV of the dropped +2.33% [+1.13,+3.55] on 40 closes (G1 +2.36 on 22, G2 +2.30 on 18, H1 +2.10 on 35, H2 +3.94 on 5) vs the kept +0.27%; CLV-units forgone 0.57 a day [0.28,0.87]; inside 6 h it drops 34 (15.1 a day) at +3.34% [+1.77,+4.95]. Dropped minus kept holds under each close source: Tracker +2.31 [+0.25,+4.31] (26 vs 68), independent +1.02 [+0.02,+2.03] (8 vs 31; dropped +0.23, kept -0.80).

REQUIRE ANY SHARP-RANKED BOOK (PASSED only) vs today drops exactly the 18 judged NO_SHARP props (8.0 a day logged, 13 games): CLV +1.59% [-1.94,+5.35] on 9 closes, ROI -39.96% [-79.19,+13.78] on 16 settled (5-11); CLV-units forgone 0.13 a day [-0.16,+0.43]. Too thin to call; only 3 of 18 would pass the auto-bet's other criteria (checkEv 2.5%, 2+ two-sided books, 3+ agreeing, -200 to +130), because a page with no sharp book averages 1.5 two-sided books vs 5.

Today's veto (bar 1%) drops 63 props (27.9 a day logged) whose CLV is -0.10% [-1.62,+1.73] on 44 closes: forgone -0.03 CLV-units a day [-0.45,+0.48]: neutral. A 2% bar (an offered choice) drops 36 more (16 a day, 18 games): CLV +0.19% [-1.01,+1.61] on 20 closes, ROI -23.2% [-55.5,+3.9]; inside 6 h it drops 20 (8.9 a day) at -0.23% [-2.08,+2.26] on 11 closes. Bars of 3-4% drop bets whose CLV is +0.47 and +0.12 (94 and 128 closes) so they are not worth it.

What the auto-bet could actually see (proxy: checkEv 2.5% or more, 2+ two-sided, 3+ agreeing, -200 to +130; 132 judged props, 58.5 a day logged, 65% of them placed): PASSED 105, VETOED 24, NO_SHARP 3. Inside 6 h (the trap guard window): 67 props (29.7 a day logged): PASSED 60, VETOED 5, NO_SHARP 2: the veto drops 5 (2.2 a day), requiring a sharp book 2 more (0.9 a day), requiring an exchange 20 more (8.9 a day, 32% of today's 62 kept). CLV kept inside 6 h: today +2.48% [+1.81,+3.26] (57 closes), require sharp +2.57% [+1.86,+3.45] (55), require exchange +1.99% [+1.41,+2.83] (39).

EV floors on props (listed EV): all props CLV +0.12% (477 closes) at no floor, +0.53 (324) at 1%, +1.19% [-0.01,+2.28] (171) at 2%, +1.67% [+0.25,+3.04] (131 closes, 33 games) at 2.5%, +2.17% [+0.50,+3.97] (91, 30 games) at 3%, +3.34% [+0.06,+6.88] (48, 19 games) at 4%. Not judged: 2.5% +1.75% [-0.81,+3.80] (59 closes), 3% +2.45% [-0.42,+5.26] (46); judged 2.5% +1.60% [+0.17,+3.15] (72). A higher floor lifts CLV in every subset, with or without a verdict.

Selection: after matching on time-to-start x listed EV, judged minus not-judged CLV = -0.02 point [-1.68,+1.43]; raw +0.83 [-0.47,+2.15]. Not-judged props within 6 h (514 bets, 43 games): CLV +1.14% [+0.14,+2.74] on 51 closes (20 games), ROI +8.19% [+1.35,+17.70] on 501; requiring a verdict to LIST would hide them (80% of listed props), and the app cannot give them a verdict anyway without reading a page for each.

Price at the check (what a bet at verdict time would pay): PASSED CLV +1.73% [+0.97,+2.44] vs VETOED +0.03% [-1.56,+2.01] (139 vs 44 closes); gap holds in G2 (+3.33 [+0.38,+6.08]) but not G1 (-0.09 [-1.35,+1.26]). Verdict from the LAST page read separates more (PASSED +0.90% [+0.04,+1.75] on 146 closes vs VETOED -0.74% [-2.70,+1.09] on 37) but a later read is nearer the close: not tradable.

To settle (80% power, 5% level, CLV sd 3.8% within 6 h, ICC about 0): about 100 closes per arm for a 1.5-point PASSED-vs-VETOED gap inside 6 h (228 for 1 point); 194 per arm over all hours (437 for 1 point). Now: VETOED inside 6 h 12 closes (5.3 a day on a heavy NFL Sunday), NO_SHARP 9 (4.0 a day). Roughly 90 more VETOED-inside-6h closes and about 90 more NO_SHARP closes, ideally on independent (non-Tracker) closes: about 3-4 weeks of logging at the current density.

findings.claim: DATA TRAP: the study's sharpVerdict NO_SHARP is mostly 'no book page was read'; only 259 of 1320 props have a verdict.
findings.evidence: sharpVerdict: NO_SHARP 830, NaN 249, PASSED 178, VETOED 63; of the 830 NO_SHARP, 812 have ab_verdict null (no page read); only 18 are real NO_SHARP. AtBets.cno() sets sharpVerdict = judge(view = null) = NO_SHARP when no page exists; BetLedger.kt Split.SHARP prints it as-is (summary 'Sharp veto' NO_SHARP 1482), while StudyExport.verdictOf() (used by the props what-if) correctly returns null. The loader docstring calls sharpVerdict real: use ab_verdict.notna().
findings.luck_risk: not a statistic: a counting fact, verified against the app's what-if counts (196/63/1061).

findings.claim: The app's what-if simulation reproduces exactly; requiring PASSED or an exchange has no CLV benefit on these closes.
findings.evidence: Today KEPT 196 (CLV +0.83 on 148 closes) / DROPPED 63 (-0.10 on 44); require sharp-ranked KEPT 178 (+0.78 on 139) / DROPPED 81 (+0.19 on 53); require exchange KEPT 141 (+0.27 on 108) / DROPPED 118 (+1.06 on 84). The rule that keeps the fewest bets has the lowest CLV.
findings.effect: kept CLV: +0.83 / +0.78 / +0.27 points for today / sharp / exchange; dropped CLV: -0.10 / +0.19 / +1.06
findings.luck_risk: differences between rules are all inside the intervals (each kept interval is about 2 points wide).

findings.claim: PASSED props close better than VETOED props only by an amount that is not distinguishable from zero, and the sign flips by date half.
findings.luck_risk: about 1 in 5 that the true gap is zero or negative; sign unstable across halves: treat as no evidence of a verdict effect.

findings.claim: Time to start, not the verdict, explains most of the PASSED-vs-VETOED gap.
findings.evidence: VETOED first listed median 586 min out vs PASSED 200; 44/63 (70%) VETOED vs 70/178 (39%) PASSED over 6 h. Within 6 h: PASSED +2.05 (81 closes) vs VETOED +0.14 (12 closes); beyond 6 h PASSED -1.00 (58) vs VETOED -0.19 (32). OLS CLV on 183 closes / 35 games: PASSED +0.1 pt (se 1.0), early -2.5 pt (se 1.0, t -2.4). Vetoes are 13.9% of judged props within 6 h and 36.1% beyond: the veto mostly acts where the 6 h trap guard already acts.
findings.effect: PASSED coefficient +0.1 point (se 1.0) once first-look time is controlled
findings.luck_risk: the early-vs-late CLV step also appears in both game-start halves (PASSED within 6 h +2.69/+1.77 vs beyond -0.64/-1.39); it matches the earlier overall finding that time to start is the one robust attribute.

findings.claim: The CLV level of prop rules is carried by Tracker closes (a CNO consensus read, only for placed bets); on independent closes every prop rule is about zero and PASSED equals VETOED.
findings.evidence: Judged within 6 h: Tracker closes +2.91 [+1.97,+4.51] (55) vs independent -0.57 [-1.43,+0.60] (32, 15 games); by half Tracker/independent G1 +5.73 (13)/+0.25 (12), G2 +2.03 (42)/-1.06 (20). PASSED: Tracker +1.05 (93), Novig trades 3+ -0.73 (34); VETOED: Tracker +0.46 (13), Novig trades -0.79 (28). PASSED-VETOED on independent closes +0.14 [-1.45,+1.47] (35 vs 28).
findings.effect: gap Tracker minus independent about +3.5 points within 6 h; verdict effect on independent closes +0.14 [-1.45,+1.47]
findings.luck_risk: the Tracker/independent gap shows in both halves; the independent samples are small (32 closes inside 6 h), so 'about zero' means 'cannot show a positive CLV', not 'proved zero'.

findings.claim: The sharp book's own edge predicts CLV within 6 h of the start but not beyond; the veto's 1% bar sits where the relation is flat.
findings.evidence: Slope of CLV on sharp edge: within 6 h +0.43 [+0.16,+0.71] (93 closes, 29 games; winsorised +0.41; close_ok +0.41; Tracker +0.22 [+0.02,+0.49]; independent +0.56 [-0.15,+0.90]); G1 +0.52 (28 closes), G2 +0.41 (65); H1 +0.56 (77), H2 -0.01 (16 closes, 6 games, too thin). Beyond 6 h -0.15 [-0.56,+0.20] (90 closes). Within 6 h bands: <1% +0.28 (13), 1-2% -0.45 (10), 2-4% +1.55 [+0.73,+2.50] (37), 4%+ +3.38 [+2.60,+4.55] (33 closes, 85% beat, ROI +34% [-3,+68]). It matches RESEARCH.md section 72 (CLV about 0.46 x the sharp edge).
findings.effect: +0.43 CLV per 1.0 of sharp edge [+0.16,+0.71] within 6 h
findings.luck_risk: bootstrap P(slope<=0) 0.003, game-level permutation p about 0.05 (29 games); about 10 slices were tried, so Bonferroni-ish p about 0.03-0.5. It replicates in both game-start halves and agrees with prior research, which helps; but see the next finding: the page consensus carries the same signal.

findings.claim: The sharp book adds nothing detectable beyond the page's own consensus EV (ab_checkEv): the consensus is the better predictor within 6 h.
findings.evidence: Within 6 h CLV on checkEv: slope +0.57 (se 0.13, t 4.4, 98 closes / 29 games); both in one model (93 closes): sharp +0.04 (se 0.19), checkEv +0.59 (se 0.19); corr(sharp edge, checkEv) 0.74; PASSED dummy +0.4 pt (se 1.3) with checkEv in. checkEv slope by half: G1 +0.86 (31 closes), G2 +0.44 (67), H1 +0.58 (82), H2 +0.64 (16). Beyond 6 h: checkEv -0.32 (se 0.34), sharp -0.15. The sharp coefficient's se (0.19) cannot exclude the 0.46 prior, so 'adds nothing' means 'adds nothing we can measure at this size'.
findings.luck_risk: the checkEv result is also a time-sliced finding (within 6 h chosen after seeing the time step), about 10 slices; t 4.4 is robust to that; it is the app's own book-check EV, not a new data source.

findings.claim: Within 6 h, props with book-check EV of 3% or more have CLV about +3% on both halves, with or without a sharp book; the verdict adds nothing to that cell.
findings.evidence: 63 bets / 27 games, +3.13% [+2.46,+4.00] on 54 closes (76% beat), ROI +1.38% [-28.25,+33.03]; H1 +3.01 (44 closes), H2 +3.64 (10); G1 +3.61 (21), G2 +2.82 (33). With PASSED too: 55 bets +3.06% (48 closes). Dropping the 4 VETOED loses 3 closes at +3.43. BUT Tracker closes +4.05 (35) vs independent -0.05 [-0.81,+0.52] (15 closes, 11 games): on independent closes it shows no CLV.
findings.luck_risk: the 3% cut was chosen from a grid (about 8 thresholds); the Tracker closes share the consensus with the EV, so part of this is circular. Needs about 100 independent closes.

findings.claim: Which book's agreement matters: originating books (FanDuel/Caesars/DraftKings) beat the exchanges, and ProphetX beats Kalshi; Kalshi's agreement is the weakest signal.
findings.evidence: Exchange PASSED 141 bets +0.27% [-1.01,+1.21] (108 closes, 24 games) vs originating PASSED 37 bets +2.55% [+1.34,+3.90] (31 closes, 19 games): +2.28 [+0.70,+4.00]; G1 +2.26 [+0.68,+3.94], G2 +2.30 [-0.25,+5.31]; within the Tracker source +2.48 (25) vs +0.52 (68); only 4 originating closes are independent (+0.49). Kalshi PASSED 63 bets -1.38% [-3.02,-0.11] (41 closes) vs ProphetX PASSED 78 bets +1.29% [-0.25,+2.49] (67): +2.67 [+0.89,+4.51], G1 +4.65, G2 +1.57 [-0.77,+3.58]; when both price both sides and both pass (39 bets) CLV -1.70 [-4.19,+0.06] (26 closes). Caesars PASSED +4.05 (16 closes). Per-book slopes of CLV on that book's own edge within 6 h are positive for 8 of 9 books that have 20+ closes there (DraftKings +0.47 t 2.5, Kalshi +0.67 t 2.2, FanDuel +0.33 t 1.9), none robust.
findings.effect: originating minus exchange +2.28 points [+0.70,+4.00]; ProphetX minus Kalshi +2.67 [+0.89,+4.51]
findings.luck_risk: about 20 book-level comparisons: 1 expected by luck at 95%; several clear it, and the sign repeats in both halves, but the originating group is 37 bets / 4 independent closes and Kalshi's negative CLV (41 closes) may be a thin-market artifact. A lead, not a rule.

findings.claim: Props with no exchange on the page close better than props an exchange prices: an exchange line is not a quality stamp.
findings.evidence: No exchange two-sided: 57 bets, +2.28% [+1.10,+3.45] (42 closes, 23 games); exchange two-sided: 202 bets, +0.15% [-0.91,+1.02] (150 closes, 26 games): +2.13 [+0.76,+3.57]; G1 +1.63 [-0.01,+3.01], G2 +2.48 [+0.33,+5.04]; within 6 h +1.87 [+0.15,+3.47]; Tracker closes +2.33 [-0.02,+4.52] (27 vs 80), independent +1.05 [-0.09,+2.04] (9 vs 58). The no-exchange props carry a higher listed EV (2.75% vs 1.86%) and checkEv (5.5% vs 2.7%); controlling early and checkEv the exchange coefficient is -1.8 points (se 0.9).
findings.effect: +2.13 points [+0.76,+3.57] for 'no exchange on the page'
findings.luck_risk: post-hoc (no prior), about 70 comparisons looked at: moderate luck risk; consistent in both halves and under both close sources, so worth logging, not worth a rule.

findings.claim: Requiring an exchange would drop the props with the best CLV in this log; requiring any sharp-ranked book only drops 18 props nobody can evaluate.
findings.evidence: Require exchange vs today: dropped 55 bets (24.4 a day logged, 27 games) CLV +2.33% [+1.13,+3.55] (40 closes) vs kept +0.27% (108): forgone 0.57 CLV-units a day [0.28,0.87]; halves G1 +2.36 (22), G2 +2.30 (18), H1 +2.10 (35), H2 +3.94 (5); inside 6 h dropped 34 (15.1 a day) at +3.34% [+1.77,+4.95] (25 closes). Under each close source dropped > kept (Tracker +2.31 [+0.25,+4.31], independent +1.02 [+0.02,+2.03]). Require any sharp book: dropped 18 NO_SHARP (8.0 a day), 9 closes CLV +1.59 [-1.94,+5.35], forgone 0.13 units a day [-0.16,+0.43].
findings.luck_risk: the exchange rule is more likely to cost CLV than to add it; the dropped group is 26 Tracker closes and 8 independent closes (+0.23), so the strength is moderate.

findings.claim: A higher edge floor for props with no sharp book cannot be tested: only 18 judged props are NO_SHARP, 9 with a close.
findings.evidence: NO_SHARP judged: 18 bets / 13 games, 9 closes (7 games) CLV +1.59 [-1.94,+5.35], 44% beat, ROI -39.96% [-79.19,+13.78] on 16 (5-11), listed EV 3.18%; 4 independent closes -0.04. Proxy: the 1061 not-judged props by listed-EV floor: 2.5% +1.75% [-0.81,+3.80] (59 closes), 3% +2.45% [-0.42,+5.26] (46), within 6 h at 2.5% +2.64% [-0.94,+6.64] (10 closes). Every subset shows CLV rising with the floor (all props 2.5% +1.67 [+0.25,+3.04], 131 closes; H1 +1.73 on 119, H2 +1.05 on 12), so an EV floor works without any sharp book, and the auto-bet already floors at 2.5%.
findings.effect: NO_SHARP too thin; not-judged floor sweep +1.75% at 2.5% [-0.81,+3.80]
findings.luck_risk: the floor effect is the app's general EV result; for NO_SHARP specifically about 90 more closes are needed.

findings.claim: Today's veto at 1% is neutral; a 2% bar (offered in Settings) or any higher bar buys no CLV worth its dropped bets.
findings.effect: 1% to 2% bar: +0.1 point kept CLV, dropped group +0.19 [-1.01,+1.61] on 20 closes
findings.luck_risk: differences are far inside the intervals; a 2% bar is a coin flip on 20 closes (about 100 per arm needed).

findings.claim: Selection: judged props are the high-EV, near-start top of the scan, and matching on EV and time removes the judged advantage; not-judged props within 6 h look as good as judged ones.
findings.evidence: Judged vs not: listed EV 2.05% vs 1.25%; 33% vs 14% at 2.5%+; median first look 255 vs 383 min out; shown 66% vs 37%; CNO books 8.2 vs 7.4; placed 42% vs 8%; looks 43 vs 17; mean EV rank in its first-look minute 8.6 vs 12.6; chance of being judged among props the list showed, by EV rank in the first-look minute: rank 1-3 39%, 4-10 31%, 11-20 22%, 21-50 21%, over 50 7%; over all props, by listed EV: 1% or under 11%, 2.5-3% 47%. Judged sources are all CNO (c+w 56%, c+v+w 42%, c 1.5%); not-judged are 47% wide-only and 16% Vigilant-only. CLV judged minus not judged: raw +0.83 [-0.47,+2.15]; matched on time x EV -0.02 [-1.68,+1.43]. Within 6 h not judged: 514 bets, CLV +1.14% [+0.14,+2.74] (51 closes), ROI +8.19% [+1.35,+17.70]; shown + not judged within 6 h 133 bets CLV +1.63% [-0.06,+3.79] (29 closes). The verdict mix of the judged (69% PASSED, 24% VETOED, 7% NO_SHARP; VETOED 14% within 6 h vs 36% beyond) would be a guess for the rest.
findings.luck_risk: matching uses 6 cells (time x EV) so it is crude; it says the verdict set is not better for being judged, not that unjudged props are as good.

findings.claim: The verdict is taken minutes to hours after the first look and changes: tradable CLV should be measured at the check price, and a later verdict leaks information.
findings.evidence: Check lag median 14.7 min (mean 135, p75 165, max 2528 min); 182 of 259 over 60 s. PASSED CLV by lag: under 1 min +2.45 (48 closes), 1-15 min +0.85, 15 min-2 h +0.61, over 2 h -1.49 [-3.53,-0.01] (34 closes). 22 of 259 bets changed verdict across page reads (12 of the 63 first-VETOED were PASSED at the last read). At the check price PASSED +1.73% [+0.97,+2.44] vs VETOED +0.03% [-1.56,+2.01]; PASSED-VETOED G1 -0.09 [-1.35,+1.26], G2 +3.33 [+0.38,+6.08]. The last-read verdict gap is +1.64 (PASSED +0.90 on 146 closes vs VETOED -0.74 on 37).
findings.effect: gap at check price +1.70 points; unstable by half
findings.luck_risk: the check price is a reasonable decision price but the bets that are checked later are the early ones, so the lag effect is the time effect again.

findings.claim: How many bets/games would settle it.
findings.evidence: CLV sd 3.8% within 6 h (98 closes), 5.2% all judged (192), ICC about 0 (design effect 1.0-1.3). Per arm at 80% power / 5% level: 1.5-point gap: 101 closes within 6 h, 194 all hours, 333 beyond 6 h; 1-point gap: 228 / 437 / 749. Now VETOED within 6 h 12 closes, NO_SHARP 9, originating PASSED 31 (4 independent).
findings.effect: about 90 more VETOED-within-6h closes, about 90 more NO_SHARP closes, about 70 more originating-PASSED closes; 3-4 weeks at the current density
findings.luck_risk: estimates assume the sd seen here; a weekday slate has fewer props than an NFL Sunday, so the calendar time could be longer.

app_changes_implied: PROPOSAL (a QUESTION for Tj, my recommendation is NO CHANGE): do not add a 'require a sharp prop book' or 'require an exchange' rule to the taker auto-bet, the alerts or the CNO list. Evidence: PASSED minus VETOED CLV +0.88 point [-1.05,+2.53] (139 vs 44 closes) that vanishes once time-to-start is controlled (+0.1, se 1.0) and on independent closes (+0.14 [-1.45,+1.47]); requiring an exchange drops 55 of 196 props (24.4 a day logged) whose CLV is +2.33 [+1.13,+3.55]. The only rule that cleanly changes bets is 'require any sharp-ranked book' = drop 18 NO_SHARP props (8 a day logged, 3 of them auto-bet eligible, 2 inside 6 h): too thin to judge (9 closes). Settling it needs about 90 more NO_SHARP closes and about 90 more VETOED-within-6h closes (3-4 weeks).

If Tj still wants it later, build it as an OFF-by-default option: a new ScanSettings field (next to sharpVetoMinEv, ScanSettings.kt) such as sharpRequireProps; data/scanner/SharpVeto.kt judge() returning VETOED (a new reason 'no sharp book prices this prop both ways') for kind == PROP and verdict NO_SHARP; the same call sites that already use judge(): app/AutoBettor.kt sharpReason(), app/SharpGate.unvetoedAlerts(), data/tracker/AtBet.kt AtBets.cno(); and a new PresetRules field with a default of false in data/scanner/Presets.kt so saved presets still load. Bids already have this switch (MakerQuote.requireSharp, set by QuickLikely and LowUsage); this proposal does not touch it.

PROPOSAL (QUESTION): keep sharpVetoMinEv at 1% (SharpVeto.DEFAULT_MIN_EV; Presets.kt VOLUME 0.01, STRICT 0.02). The veto drops 63 props with CLV -0.10 (neutral); a 2% bar would drop 36 more at +0.19 [-1.01,+1.61] (20 closes): no case for either direction yet.

PROPOSAL (QUESTION, exploratory): the prop ranking in SharpVeto.ranking() is KI, PX, FD, CZR (DK, FD on MLB). In this log Kalshi's agreement is the weakest (Kalshi PASSED -1.38 [-3.02,-0.11] on 41 closes vs ProphetX PASSED +1.29 [-0.25,+2.49] on 67; difference +2.67 [+0.89,+4.51], both halves positive) and a prop an exchange does not price closes better (+2.13 [+0.76,+3.57]). Do not reorder on this: about 20 book comparisons, 37 originating-PASSED bets with 4 independent closes. Log it (next_logging) and revisit at 100+ closes per book.

No change proposed to autoBetMinEv (2.5%): eligible props inside 6 h that were not vetoed closed +1.99% [+1.07,+2.54] at checkEv 2.5-3% (14 bets, 12 closes) vs +2.61% [+1.73,+3.47] at 3% or more (48 bets, 45 closes): raising to 3% would drop 14 bets for no clear gain. The 6 h trap guard (TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS = 6) is where the prop edge is; the sharp verdict acts mostly beyond it.

CODE FIX (not a rule change, for the CX3 fault list): BetLedger.kt Split.SHARP / Split.SHARP_BOOK print atBet.sharpVerdict as is, so every bet with no book page is counted as NO_SHARP ('none on the page'): NO_SHARP 1482 in the study summary, 1442 of them with no page. Make them say 'no book page was read' the way StudyExport.verdictOf() already does for props (a record is judged only if checkAtMs, twoSided or books is present). Same for the loader docstring in the scan-study READ ME.
next_logging: Read the book page for EVERY listed prop at its first look (CNO game pages are free and one page serves every prop of a game): record sharpVerdict, sharpBook, sharpEv and each book's price and edge at the first look. Today 80.4% of props never get a page and the first read is a median 14.7 min (up to 42 h) after the first look, which makes the verdict a later, partly look-ahead read.

Stamp what price the verdict was judged at (checkAmerican, checkNovigAgeSec) in atBet and print CLV at the check price next to CLV at the first-listed price; today the check price is only recoverable from the 'k' look.

Give every judged prop a sharp, independent close: re-read the CNO page of each judged prop's game in the last 3-5 minutes before the start and log Kalshi, ProphetX, FanDuel, Caesars, DraftKings, Pinnacle and Circa two-sided prices, so the close does not depend on Tj having placed the bet (Tracker, 55% of judged closes within 6 h, is a CNO consensus read) or on thin Novig trades (95 of the Novig-trade closes rest on 1-2 trades). Tag each close as consensus / sharp-book / Novig trades with the trade count.

Log a random sample of NOT-judged props (for example 5 per scan, chosen at random from the whole list rather than the top 10) with a page read, plus the prop's rank in CNO's list at the first look, so the effect of the top-10 selection can be measured instead of guessed.

Log verdict stability: every page read's verdict and sharp edge per bet (already in the k looks) plus the sharp book's price age, and a flag when Kalshi and ProphetX both price both sides but disagree (of the 78 props Kalshi and ProphetX both price both ways, they disagree on 26: Kalshi pass/ProphetX veto 18, Kalshi veto/ProphetX pass 8).

Log VETOED props with the same closes as placed ones (they are rarely placed, so they get thin Novig-trade closes): the VETOED-within-6h cell has only 12 closes and is the one that would settle the veto's value.

Log whether an exchange lists the prop at all (Kalshi/ProphetX market present even when one-sided), the day of week and the sport/league slate size, so the exchange-presence lead (+2.13 [+0.76,+3.57] for no exchange) and the one-NFL-Sunday density (157 of 192 judged closes on Oct 4) can be separated.
